clips.title: The story
paras: Outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Grif Wildheart trains young hunters. He teaches tracking, marksmanship, and how to tame beasts, guiding hunters from Coldridge Valley toward life alongside an animal companion.

Grif Wildheart has spent his life in Dun Morogh’s frozen wilds. Ironforge dwarves often choose the forge or the mines, while local mountaineers say Grif spends too much time among four-legged beasts. None question his command of the wild. Years of tracking snowbound ridges with seasoned hunting companions have taught him the ways of the predators roaming the crags.

Young dwarf hunters finish their first trials in Coldridge Valley, then travel to Kharanos for Grif’s guidance. He sharpens their aim and teaches them to survive in the wild, but his true craft is joining hunter and beast. He sends pupils into Dun Morogh’s freezing wastes with a taming rod, where they face Large Crag Boars, Snow Leopards, and Ice Claw Bears.

After a hunter calms three kinds of wild beasts, Grif’s training in Kharanos is complete. A hunter must also learn to feed, discipline, and train a new companion, so Grif sends his graduates up the mountainside to Ironforge. Beneath the capital’s vaulted roofs, they report to master beast trainers and learn to care for a companion meant to stay with them for life.
